invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null TiledMapImageLayer parameter and uses it immediately.
A call to layer.getTextureRegion() is always permitted at method entry, though the result may be null or not null.
layer.getParallaxX() is called within the method, so it must be a valid float (can be positive, negative, or zero).
layer.getParallaxY() is called within the method, so it must be a valid float (can be positive, negative, or zero).
layer.isRepeatX() may return true or false and is safely callable at method entry.
